Who we are
About Stripe and Bridge
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Bridge, acquired by Stripe in 2025, is an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement.

We're looking for a driven, strategic, and results-oriented PMM to join the product marketing team at Bridge, focused on our Open Issuance, Orchestration and FX product lines.
As an early PMM for Bridge, you’ll be responsible for product marketing across the lifecycle, from helping shape the product with market insights, to crafting messaging, to growing product awareness and adoption in partnership with Sales, Marketing, Product, and more. This is a highly-cross functional role that will work both across the teams at Bridge and at Stripe to help grow the Bridge business.
You’ll be embedded with the Bridge team while also being part of the Stripe product marketing team.

Be a storyteller. You have deep empathy for our core audience and are able to adapt how you communicate to best reach and engage your audience. You can translate complex infrastructure concepts—stablecoin issuance, cross-border FX, payment orchestration—into clear, compelling narratives that differentiate Bridge.
Lead with data. You like working with data and insights and pair that with your passion for users to generate balanced and thoughtful points of view for how to take products to market
Keep things organized . You are able to manage highly interdependent, complex projects and keep various work streams on track. You're comfortable running multiple launches in parallel across different product lines and coordinating across Bridge, Privy, and Stripe teams.
Have a passion for fintech and crypto. You are keen to learn about how things work and are able to explain technical concepts in ways that everyday people can understand. You’re deeply curious about fintech and crypto and translate that passion into impactful product marketing.
Be ambitious and thrive in complexity. You are eager to make an impact at Bridge (and consequently, Stripe). You thrive in a fast-moving, dynamic, hyper-growth environment and are able to operate fluidly between the 30,000-foot strategy level and the micro-detail to get things right
Act as a team player. Product Marketers collaborate with basically every team in the business. You are able to work with a range of disciplines to execute on your work

Own the end-to-end product marketing strategy for Open Issuance, Orchestration and FX, including messaging, positioning, ICP definition, sales enablement, and demand generation campaigns
Drive go-to-market for product expansions (new currencies, corridors, pricing improvements), ensuring GTM teams have the right positioning, playbooks, and enablement content from day one
Build and maintain competitive positioning in a crowded market, clearly articulating Bridge's differentiation to the right developer and customer segments
Lead marketing for product releases and launches across your product areas, coordinating with product, comms, content, and demand gen
Create and maintain sales and marketing assets (case studies, solution pages, pitch decks, one-pagers, enablement and trainings) that drive pipeline conversion
Act as a liaison between Bridge and Stripe product marketing to bring connectivity across the marketing strategy for both parts of the business
Flex into other Bridge marketing needs as they arise, supporting the broader team during peak moments

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

5+ years of relevant experience including B2B product marketing, marketing, product management, and management consulting
Ability to be agile and thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Experience in working in businesses that offer API-based products, fintech and crypto experience is a plus
Action-oriented and comfortable moving forward without clear guidelines or instructions
Excellent writing and communication skills with the ability to simplify complex topics for diverse audiences
Strong analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making
Strong cross-functional relationship builder at all levels of an organization

Spotify Advertising is looking for a highly-autonomous and strategic Marketing Manager, to lead our advertising business marketing efforts for enterprise brands and media agencies, across the Australia & New Zealand (ANZ) markets.
Part of our International Advertising Business Marketing team, this position focuses on driving awareness, consideration and demand for Spotify's Advertising solutions to enterprise brands and media agencies, ensuring Spotify's core ads messaging and products resonate with local audiences.
You will bring a deep understanding of the ANZ media landscape and proven experience scaling marketing campaigns and education programs that drive advertiser adoption.
This role will report to the JAPAC Advertising Business Marketing Director, based in Sydney.

Develop and execute the Spotify Advertising business marketing strategy in the ANZ markets, with activation across paid, owned, and earned channels tailored to enterprise brands and media agencies
Localize global programs, sales collateral, and content to ensure relevance and impact in the ANZ markets
Manage the ANZ advertising marketing budget, tracking effectiveness and ROI of marketing investments
Lead presence at key industry events and partnerships, elevating Spotify's brand visibility and relevance with target audiences
Support local trade PR efforts in coordination with the PR and Comms team and Sales leads
Act as a senior stakeholder in cross-functional ANZ planning, setting KPIs, and defining strategic priorities aligned with sales objectives
Act as the strategic voice of the ANZ advertiser, proactively identifying opportunities, surfacing unmet needs, and informing global roadmaps
Build strong working relationships to collaborate cross-functionally with all key stakeholders including Sales leadership, PR, and the wider global ads business marketing teams to ensure unified, results-driven programs
Partner closely with the Head of Sales, ANZ to align marketing strategy with commercial objectives and ensure coordinated go-to-market execution
Operate with strong ownership of both local and regional strategies, acting as a subject-matter expert on the enterprise advertising landscape and ANZ market dynamics
Report on program performance and key KPIs, using insights to optimize and evolve strategies, while managing the country budgets
Manage agency and vendor relationships where needed, ensuring high-quality delivery of experiential and digital programs

A minimum of 8+ years of B2B marketing experience in digital media or advertising, with a strong focus on enterprise brands and media agencies
Deep understanding of the ANZ media and advertising landscape and how to influence decision-makers at brands and agencies
Demonstrated experience building and scaling marketing strategies for enterprise brands, particularly in multi-market or ANZ contexts
Experience with demand generation channels, paid marketing, and performance optimization
Proven ability to manage multiple projects, budgets, and stakeholders across functions and geographies
Highly self-sufficient, with a collaborative mindset and ability to manage complexity and ambiguity
Data-driven and analytical, with a focus on learning, optimization, and measurable impact
Experience managing agencies, budgets, and vendor relationships with discipline and efficiency
Confident communicator with strong presentation and storytelling skills, comfortable influencing senior stakeholders

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our Sydney office
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in at least 2 times per week for client meetings, events, and team collaboration

About Outreach

Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions.

From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team.

World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few.

At Outreach, what we build changes how thousands of sales teams sell every day. We're looking for a Principal Product Marketing Manager, Competitive to shape how we understand, position, and compete in the rapidly evolving revenue technology market.
In this role, you'll own competitive intelligence across our AI and revenue platform portfolio, turning customer, competitor, and market insights into differentiated narratives, strategic recommendations, and competitive programs that help our Sales, Marketing, Partner, and Customer teams win.

As a senior individual contributor, you'll influence go-to-market decisions, anticipate market shifts, and serve as a trusted advisor to leaders across the organization. If you're passionate about turning market intelligence into competitive advantage, you'll thrive in this role.

At Outreach, product marketing doesn't just support the business, it shapes how thousands of revenue teams experience the platform every day. You'll join a tight-knit team that works at the center of Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Experience, tackling problems with a direct line to customer outcomes and company growth.
We're curious, collaborative, and a little obsessed with making things better. We push each other to do our best work, enjoy doing it and we genuinely have each other's backs.

Your Daily Adventures Will Include
Lead competitive intelligence and market research, translating customer, competitor, and industry insights into differentiated positioning and strategic recommendations.
Serve as the subject matter expert on competitive dynamics, buyer priorities, market trends, and AI innovations, translating insights into battlecards, executive briefs, and enablement programs that improve seller confidence and win rates.
Develop portfolio-level competitive narratives and messaging that clearly articulate Outreach's differentiation.
Lead cross-functional initiatives that strengthen Outreach's competitive position and improve GTM effectiveness.
Influence Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leaders on competitive priorities and market opportunities.
Act as a trusted advisor to GTM leaders, using data-driven insights to shape go-to-market strategy, content investments, and positioning.
Monitor market shifts, competitive moves, and AI trends to identify opportunities and risks that inform strategy.
Represent Outreach with customers, analysts, and industry audiences as a leader in competitive strategy and market intelligence.
Our vision of you
Lead competitive intelligence and market research, translating customer, competitor, and industry insights into differentiated positioning and strategic recommendations.
Serve as the subject matter expert on competitive dynamics, buyer priorities, market trends, and AI innovations, translating insights into battlecards, executive briefs, and enablement programs that improve seller confidence and win rates.
Develop portfolio-level competitive narratives and messaging that clearly articulate Outreach's differentiation.
Lead cross-functional initiatives that strengthen Outreach's competitive position and improve GTM effectiveness.
Influence Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leaders on competitive priorities and market opportunities.
Act as a trusted advisor to GTM leaders, using data-driven insights to shape go-to-market strategy, content investments, and positioning.
Monitor market shifts, competitive moves, and AI trends to identify opportunities and risks that inform strategy.
Represent Outreach with customers, analysts, and industry audiences as a leader in competitive strategy and market intelligence.

s.h: The mindset to succeed in the role
s.t:
Strategic and forward-looking, with the ability to anticipate market shifts and translate insights into actionable recommendations
Naturally curious about customers, competitors, and emerging technologies, continuously seeking opportunities to strengthen Outreach's market position
An influential leader who builds alignment and drives outcomes across organizations without formal authority
An exceptional storyteller and communicator who can equip executive leaders, sellers, and marketers with compelling narratives that win in the market
Comfortable operating in ambiguity, balancing long-term strategic thinking with rapid execution and measurable business impact
Passionate about helping customer-facing teams succeed and creating competitive advantages that translate into revenue growth

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

We are in search of exceptional product marketing talent to help us promote highly scalable, true multitenant cloud solutions that are significantly impacting life sciences. Our focus is on customer satisfaction, employee success, and growth.
The Product Marketing Manager / Senior Manager – Commercial Content will be responsible for driving content and messaging for Commercial Content. This person will support marketing and sales enablement activities across the customer lifecycle and collaborate closely with other marketing functions, strategy, sales, and more.

Lead product marketing activities and content creation
Create compelling written content (e.g. thought leadership, website copy, blog posts, infographics) to articulate the benefits of the products to the market
Create clear, crisp powerpoint content, including sales decks, enablement materials, and customer presentations
Partner closely with strategy to gain a deep understanding of the market for your products and the product vision - and determine how best to communicate this externally
Create a strategic marketing plan for your products, in conjunction with field marketing and strategy
Contribute to our annual customer conferences in the US and Europe by helping with agenda development, working with customers on their presentations, and executing other workstreams as needed
Lead product and feature launch content creation and processes
Assist with sales enablement and support field marketing campaigns as needed

3+ years of B2B product marketing experience
Excellent writing and powerpoint skills
Demonstrated ability to develop clear, concise, compelling messaging and content
Strong project management skills with attention to detail
Fast learner, and must enjoy fast-paced work environments
Proven ability to build relationships with other teams and stakeholders
Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
Interviewing with Veeva
We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
Follow the application process and submit your resume.
Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.

s.h: If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows
s.t:
A conversation with the hiring manager
A practical case exercise
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
Retirement programs
1% charitable giving program

Base pay: $ 75,000 - $135,000
The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location.

We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Veeva QualityOne is expanding in Korea, and we are looking for a Senior Marketing Manager to help build the market for QualityOne across regulated manufacturing industries such as cosmetics, food & beverage, and chemicals.
This is a hands-on, high-impact role for a marketer who can turn global product strategy into local market demand. You will work closely with the Director, QualityOne Korea and regional marketing leadership to create segment-specific campaigns, build local thought leadership, and contribute directly to pipeline growth.

Own Korea GTM marketing execution for QualityOne, adapting global strategy to local customer segments such as cosmetics brand owners, OEM/ODMs, F&B manufacturers, and chemical manufacturers.
Create localized content and sales enablement, including Korean whitepapers, executive presentations, campaign messaging, customer stories, event themes, and sales-ready materials.
Plan and execute high-touch field programs such as executive roundtables, webinars, association events, and account-based campaigns focused on quality, supplier governance, compliance, audit readiness, and operational scalability.
Partner closely with sales to prioritize target accounts, support account planning, improve MQL-to-SQL conversion, and connect marketing activity to measurable pipeline outcomes.
Build local market awareness through Korean-language thought leadership, trade media, industry associations, partner ecosystems, and customer-facing events.
Manage campaign operations, budget, reporting, and performance analysis using marketing automation and CRM tools such as HubSpot.
Collaborate with APAC and global marketing teams to localize messaging while sharing Korea market insights back into regional and global planning.

8+ years of B2B marketing experience in Korea, ideally in enterprise software, SaaS, manufacturing technology, supply chain, PLM, ERP, MES, quality, or compliance-related solutions.
Experience building demand for a new product, category, market, or business unit where brand awareness and market education were still developing.
Strong hands-on field marketing and demand generation experience, including ABM, executive events, webinars, content campaigns, and sales enablement.
Excellent Korean writing skills with the ability to create clear, executive-level content for customers, campaigns, and local thought leadership.
Proven ability to work closely with sales or business leadership and connect marketing programs to pipeline generation, conversion quality, and target-account engagement.
Strong analytical and operational discipline, including campaign measurement, budget management, and CRM/marketing automation usage. HubSpot experience is a plus.
Professional English fluency for collaboration with regional and global teams.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Experience marketing to cosmetics, consumer goods, food & beverage, chemicals, or other regulated manufacturing industries.
Familiarity with QMS, document control, supplier quality, PLM, ERP, MES, audit management, or regulatory/compliance workflows.
Prior experience as an early or founding marketer for a global B2B SaaS company in Korea.
Existing network with Korean cosmetics brand owners, OEM/ODMs, industry associations, regulatory advisors, or manufacturing technology partners.

Who We Are
Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together . We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.
Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era.

From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

Notion's engineering and product teams are shipping faster than ever, which means there's more for customers to discover, understand, and adopt than ever before. We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to drive awareness of new Notion features and capabilities, and to run the programs that turn early activation into lasting adoption.

You're a messaging master with a genuine point of view — someone who can build narratives sharp and specific enough to cut through an increasingly noisy market — and a strategic partner to Product from early development all the way through go-to-market.
This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

Lead launches big and small, coordinating efforts across our Marketing and GTM org to land a successful launch day.
Drive continued awareness, growth, and adoption of high-PMF features well after launch day — launch is the start of the story, not the end of it.
Serve as a strategic partner to Product, informing strategy during product development, competitive positioning, and user insights.
Collaborate with Enterprise PMMs and Sales to build sales enablement materials that turn product capability into stories reps can use in the field.
Maintain and improve our release comms channels — including notion.com/releases and What's New emails — partnering with Demand Gen and Lifecycle on sequences, webinars, and more.

A distinctive point of view and the creativity to build narratives that stand out in a crowded, noisy market.
Experience running product launches and adoption programs, ideally at a fast-moving product or technology company.
Strong cross-functional skills — comfortable coordinating Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing toward one outcome.
Genuine passion for shaping the future of work with AI, a growth mindset, and a scrappy, high-ownership approach to getting things done.
Sharp writing and storytelling instincts — you know the difference between a headline that's technically accurate and one that actually lands.

You're already a Notion user, fluent in the product and plugged into the community.
You look beyond just AI & tech companies for creative inspiration
You're a pro at building and using agents — inside Notion and beyond.
PMM experience at a larger company — though we care more about your instincts and ownership than your resume's logos.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Join the Sleep Fitness Movement
At Eight Sleep, we’re on a mission to fuel human potential through optimal sleep. As the world’s first sleep fitness company, we’re redefining what it means to be well-rested and building the most advanced hardware, software, and AI technology to make it possible. Our products power peak mental, physical, and emotional performance by transforming every night of sleep into a personalized, data-driven recovery experience.
We are trusted by high performers, professional athletes, and health-conscious consumers in over 35 countries worldwide. Recognized as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies in 2019, 2022, 2023, and 2026, and twice named to TIME's “Best Inventions of the Year.” We operate like a high-performance team: fast, focused, and motivated by impact. We don’t just ship; we iterate, refine, and obsess over the details that help our members sleep better and wake up stronger.
Every role at Eight Sleep is a chance to create cutting-edge technology, collaborate with world-class talent, and help shape a future where sleep isn’t passive - it’s a powerful tool for living better. If you’re tired of the ordinary and driven to build at the edge of what’s possible, this is your moment. Join us and lead the movement that’s transforming how the world sleeps and what we’re all capable of when we wake up.
High Standards. No Apologies
We operate with intensity because our mission demands it. At Eight Sleep, we bring the same mindset as the world’s top performers: focused, relentless, and always pushing to be in the top 1% of our craft. Think Kobe Bryant’s mamba mentality, applied to bold ideas, next-gen tech, and flawless execution. This isn’t a 9-to-5.

We’re a team that puts in the extra effort, not because it’s required, but because we care about the impact of our work. We’re here to build fast, push limits, and deliver without compromise. If you thrive under pressure and want to do the most meaningful work of your career, you’ll feel right at home.

If you’re looking for something easier – this isn’t it.

We are seeking a International Performance Marketing Manager with experience in managing campaigns on Meta, Google Search, YouTube, and/or TikTok as well as a quantitative background leveraging statistics and AI. The role sits within our Global Growth Marketing team and reports directly to the Growth Marketing Lead. It will focus on optimizing and scaling our digital advertising presence in international markets, managing multiple accounts.
This is a high-impact role for a strategic, analytical, and creative individual passionate about transforming complex technology into simple, human, and aspirational advertising that delivers business results.
How you’ll contribute
Lead performance marketing channels, including but not limited to Meta, Search, Shopping, YouTube, and TikTok
Build new growth and automation systems using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, n8n, and similar) to eliminate manual work and increase marketing efficiency
Analyze campaign performance, evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs), work closely with the Performance & Data team to consolidate learnings and optimize campaigns
Analyze and recommend new copy & creative, bidding strategies, and testing structures using both qualitative and quantitative metrics at a rapid pace
Stay up to date on relevant industry trends, new ad products, and best practices
What you need to succeed
3+ years of experience with at one of Google, YouTube, Meta, and TikTok Ads with proven success working on campaigns for direct-to-consumer brands, with budgets above $1M per year
Experience with analytics tools (e.g., Excel, Google Sheets, Looker, Mode, Hex, Tableau, SQL, Amplitude, Google Search Console, keyword planner)
Experience building automation and tools with AI such as Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, n8n, Cursor, etc. for marketing and analytics applications
Strong familiarity with marketing funnels + modern attribution platforms (Northbeam, Triple Whale, Rockerbox or equivalent)
Ability to develop and continually expand or refine targeting/copy/assets based on performance
Experience designing or reading geo-lift, conversion lift, or brand lift studies
Ability to work independently, proactively creating plans from the ground up
Analytical mindset with creative intuition. Equally fluent in metrics and emotion
International awareness, with knowledge of diverse cultures
Strong, proactive communication skills with a can-do, positive attitude and a strong desire to get things done

s.h: Why You'll Love Working at Eight Sleep
s.t:
Innovation in a culture of excellence
Join us in a workplace where innovation isn’t just encouraged - it’s a standard. Our flagship product, the Pod, is a testament to our culture of excellence, beloved by hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide. At Eight Sleep, you will be part of a team that continuously pushes the boundaries of technology in sleep fitness.

s.h: Immediate responsibility and accelerated career growth
s.t:
From your first day, you’ll take on substantial responsibilities that have a direct impact on our core business and product success. We are a small team that empowers you to own your projects and see the tangible effects of your efforts, enhancing both your professional growth and our company’s trajectory. Your path will be challenging but rewarding, perfect for those who thrive in fast-paced environments aiming for high standards.
Collaboration with exceptional talent
Work alongside other bright minds like you: at Eight Sleep exceptional intelligence and a passion for breakthroughs are the norms. Our team members are not only experts in their fields but also avid innovators who thrive in our dynamic, fast-paced environment.

s.h: Equitable compensation and continuous equity investment
s.t: We extend equity participation to every full-time team member, recognizing and rewarding your direct contributions to our success. This includes periodic equity refreshments based on performance, ensuring that as Eight Sleep grows and succeeds, so do you – perfectly aligning your achievements with the broader triumphs of the company.
Every role at Eight Sleep includes competitive compensation and benefits. Final compensation will depend on experience, location, and level.
Every Eight Sleep employee receives the very product that defines our mission: a Pod of their own. If you join us you’ll get your own Pod , along with*:

Flexible PTO
Paid parental leave
Team offsites and company events
Employee discount on Eight Sleep products
Opportunity to work with a world-class team building category-defining technology

Du willst nicht nur Kampagnen steuern, sondern einen Markt wirklich mit aufbauen?
Für ein wachsendes Digital-Health-Unternehmen suchen wir eine erfahrene Marketingpersönlichkeit, die die nordischen Märkte weiterentwickelt und Marketing nicht als reine Kanalsteuerung versteht. In dieser Rolle verbindest du Performance Marketing mit Markenaufbau, lokalen Marktinsights und einer klaren kommerziellen Perspektive.
Du arbeitest eng mit Growth, BI, Product und externen Partnern zusammen und hast echten Gestaltungsspielraum: von der Kampagnenplanung über die operative Umsetzung bis zur Analyse und Weiterentwicklung des gesamten Funnels.
Aufgaben
Du übernimmst die Marketingverantwortung für Schweden, Dänemark und Finnland.
Du entwickelst lokale Marketingstrategien und setzt sie kanalübergreifend um.
Du steuerst und optimierst Kampagnen über Google Ads, Meta und weitere relevante Paid-Media-Kanäle.
Du behältst zentrale Kennzahlen wie CAC, Conversion Rate, AOV und LTV im Blick und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.
Du arbeitest eng mit BI und Analytics zusammen, um Kampagnen, Zielgruppen und Customer Journeys kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
Du planst Produkt- und Markteinführungen und sorgst dafür, dass zentrale Kampagnen lokal relevant umgesetzt werden.
Neben digitalen Kanälen arbeitest du auch mit TV, OOH und weiteren Branding-Maßnahmen.
Du steuerst externe Agenturen und Partner und stellst eine hohe Qualität in Strategie und Umsetzung sicher.
Du entwickelst Prozesse und Strukturen weiter, damit Marketing über mehrere Märkte hinweg effizient skaliert werden kann.
Qualifikation
Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im Digital Marketing, Performance Marketing oder internationalen Marketing.
Du kennst dich mit Google Ads und Meta aus und kannst Kampagnen nicht nur strategisch beurteilen, sondern auch operativ verstehen.
Du arbeitest datenbasiert und kannst Marketingkennzahlen in klare Entscheidungen übersetzen.
Du hast Erfahrung in einem schnell wachsenden Umfeld, beispielsweise in E-Commerce, D2C, Subscription, Digital Health oder einem vergleichbaren digitalen Geschäftsmodell.
Du hast bereits internationale Märkte betreut; Erfahrung mit Schweden, Dänemark oder Finnland ist besonders relevant.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, pragmatisch und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung.
Du kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch.
Schwedisch, Dänisch oder Finnisch sind ein starkes Plus, aber kein Muss.

Hybrides arbeiten in München, Berlin oder auch fully remote möglich (Zu Beginn sollte eine Präsenz von 3-4 Monaten in München eingeplant werden)
Ein professionelles, engagiertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und echte Verantwortung für internationale Märkte
Ein persönliches Budget für Weiterbildung und fachliche Entwicklung
Angebote rund um Fitness sowie ein Bike Club
Zuschuss zum öffentlichen Nahverkehr
Unterstützung bei Kinderbetreuung und Kita-Suche
Angebote zur mentalen Gesundheit
Zentral gelegene Büros

Warum die Rolle spannend ist

This role is designed for someone who is passionate about building rapidly scaling products with partners, who is agentic-minded, and excited to work at the intersection of technology and marketing.

If you’re someone who gets fired up about how MCPs unlock new product possibilities, who can read a technical spec and translate it into a compelling story for a commercial audience then this role is for you.
You'll work closely alongside other experienced product marketers — contributing to our technical platform and partnership narrative. This is a high-visibility position on a team shaping Bloomreach's platform and partner strategy.

Strategic ISV Partnerships GTM (AWS, GCP, Snowflake)
Own the go-to-market motion for Bloomreach's technical partnerships. You'll develop joint positioning, support marketplace listings, help coordinate co-marketing activities, and build the collateral sales teams need to co-sell effectively with these partners. Define success metrics upfront and deliver post-mortems with real learnings.

You'll work alongside senior PMMs to build materials that help technical buyers — developers, architects, and IT leaders — understand what's possible with the Bloomreach platform. Customer Storylines & Sales Enablement
Support the team in building the materials that help sales and internal teams talk about Bloomreach's platform credibly and compellingly. This includes field-ready assets like talk tracks, discovery guides, one-pagers, and technical integration briefs — maintained, versioned, and actually used. You'll collaborate with the Enablement team to develop training content and monitor what's landing in the field.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with Product, Partnerships, Sales, CS, and Marketing to execute launches and GTM programs on time and to a high standard. Run a light project-health cadence to track owners, risks, and dependencies — and proactively flag when things need unblocking.
Take on other job-related tasks in support of PMM and business objectives as assigned. Participate actively in team meetings and professional development activities.

Up to 5 years of experience in Product Marketing, Technical Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Developer Relations, or a closely related field — ideally at a SaaS or AI company.
OR equivalent experience in a technical role (engineering, product management, solutions architecture) with a strong desire to move into marketing and storytelling.
Experience working with technology partners to jointly build and launch products, features and go-to-market sales motions.
API/MCP fluent: you understand how agentic architectures work and how technical platforms deliver value for customers and partners. You're genuinely excited about the shift toward agentic and AI-driven architectures. You won't write code every day, but you need to be comfortable reading documentation and talking to engineers.
Strong writing skills: you can make complex technical concepts accessible without losing the precision that technical buyers expect. Clarity is your superpower.
Collaborative and proactive: you thrive in cross-functional environments, take ownership without being asked, and communicate clearly when you're stuck.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in computer science, marketing, business, or a technical field preferred.
Experience working with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or other agentic AI tools in Marketing workflows would be a significant plus.

China and Japan aren't emerging markets in the way the label suggests - they're sophisticated, mature ecosystems that simply don't run on the same playbook as the rest of APAC. Different platforms, different buying cultures, different definitions of trust. We're looking for a Marketing Manager who understands that going deep in these markets is a different job entirely from running broad regional campaigns, and who's genuinely excited by that depth rather than looking to generalise it away.
You'll own integrated marketing execution across the full funnel - SMB through enterprise - for China and Japan, working closely with our Head of Marketing Asia, to build and adapt campaign strategy for markets that each deserve their own thinking - not a translated version of what works elsewhere.

You'll collaborate with Demand Generation, Brand & Content, Creative Services, Field, BDR, Sales and Partnerships to make sure campaigns are built for how buyers in these markets actually discover, evaluate, and decide, so that they move the pipeline as a result.
This is an individual contributor role. You won't have direct reports, but you'll need the judgement and stakeholder skills of someone who could.

None.
How You'll Make a Difference
Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across China and Japan, spanning paid, organic, lifecycle, field, ABM and partner marketing
Build and adapt campaign strategy for local relevance - platform choices (e.g. WeChat, Baidu, LINE), buyer behaviour, content format, and competitive context differ significantly between China and Japan, and campaigns need to reflect that rather than flatten it
Partner with BDR, Sales, field, partnerships and shared services teams to align campaign timing and messaging with market-specific pipeline goals and account priorities
Work with Brand & Content and Product Marketing to identify where existing assets translate well and where new, market-native content and localisation is needed
Develop and execute co-marketing programs with local partners - campaigns, in-market events, and webinars - that drive demand and pipeline while showcasing our joint value proposition in China and Japan
Activate partner-led marketing initiatives with the right tools, content, and guidance, and champion the partner voice internally so collaboration keeps deepening
Manage campaign calendars, budgets, and vendor relationships specific to China and Japan, including local media and platform partners
Track and report campaign performance by market and channel, with a clear point of view on what's working, what isn't, and why
Build and maintain a market-level measurement view in partnership with Marketing Analytics, so decisions are grounded in data rather than assumption
Bring forward recommendations on where investment should shift across China and Japan based on results
Establish success criteria that inform resource planning, campaign flighting, and prioritisation across multiple stakeholders
Represent the needs and constraints of these markets in global and regional campaign planning, so strategy isn't built only from a US, EMEA, or broader APAC lens
Stay informed on market trends and competitive dynamics in China and Japan, bringing fresh thinking to how we and our partners show up

5+ years in partner marketing, demand generation, or regional marketing, ideally with direct experience in China and/or Japan
Comfortable owning campaigns end-to-end, from planning through execution to reporting, without a large supporting team
Comfortable self-serving in a lean-resource environment - from copywriting, basic design, case study interviews, to event execution - are part of the job here, not someone else's
Experience managing media budgets across multiple markets, with a clear read on where spend is and isn't working
Working knowledge of the platforms and channels specific to China and Japan (e.g. WeChat, Rednote, LINE, X, local social and search ecosystems)

Introduction
Du willst nicht einfach Kampagnen abarbeiten sondern Marketing von Grund auf aufbauen? Du denkst in Systemen, hast ein Gespür für Zahlen und weißt gleichzeitig, wie man Botschaften formuliert, die ankommen?
Wir sind Omnora, eine B2B SaaS-Company aus Frankfurt. Wir helfen Unternehmen wie DB, AOK und ADAC dabei, ihr Wissen zu sichern, zu strukturieren und nutzbar zu machen - mit KI.
Als unser Marketing Manager bist du von Tag 1 an die treibende Kraft hinter unserem gesamten Marketing. Du steuerst Kampagnen über alle Kanäle hinweg, baust unsere Performance-Marketing-Infrastruktur auf und entwickelst Schritt für Schritt eine Struktur, aus der langfristig eine echte Marketingabteilung entsteht. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Management Team zusammen - ohne festgefahrene Prozesse, dafür mit echter Gestaltungsfreiheit.
Kurz gesagt: Du bist unser Founding Marketing Manager. Was du hier aufbaust, gehört dir.
What's in it for me
Founding-Role mit echter Ownership: Du baust nicht in einer Abteilung mit - du baust die Abteilung. Was du hier aufbaust, trägt langfristig deinen Fingerabdruck und bietet dir echte Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung Marketing Lead.
Blitzschnelles Lernen: Du tauchst in alle Disziplinen ein - von Content über Performance bis Automation - und lernst in Monaten, wofür andere Jahre brauchen.
Gestaltungsfreiraum: Statt festgefahrener Prozesse erwartet dich maximaler Freiraum, Dinge auszuprobieren.
Kurze Wege, großer Einfluss: Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und siehst, wie deine Arbeit das Unternehmen bewegt.
Hybrides Arbeiten: Was zählt, ist dein Beitrag - nicht wo du sitzt. Wir arbeiten hybrid aus Frankfurt mit flexiblen Home-Office-Möglichkeiten.
Der perfekte Einstiegszeitpunkt: Mit marktreifem Produkt und starken Referenzen stehen wir vor dem nächsten Wachstumsschritt - der ideale Moment, um einzusteigen und mitzugestalten.
How you can make an impact
Performance Marketing & Lead Generation: Du planst, steuerst und optimierst Kampagnen auf Google Ads und LinkedIn mit einem klaren Ziel: qualifizierte Leads für unser Sales-Team. CPL, ROAS und Pipeline-Contribution sind deine Währung - nicht nice-to-haves, sondern tägliche Steuerungsgrößen.
Account-Based Marketing: Du entwickelst ABM-Kampagnen, die gezielt Enterprise-Accounts in der DACH-Region ansprechen - mit den richtigen Botschaften, zur richtigen Zeit, auf den richtigen Kanälen.
Omni-Channel Orchestrierung: Du steuerst alle Marketingkanäle zusammen - Paid, Organic, Content, Email - und sorgst dafür, dass sie als System funktionieren statt als Einzelmaßnahmen nebeneinander zu laufen.
Content & Kreation: Du entwickelst Formate und Inhalte, die bei unseren Zielgruppen ankommen, und testest kontinuierlich, was wirklich performt - datenbasiert statt Bauchgefühl.
Marketing-Infrastruktur: Du baust eine skalierbare Infrastruktur auf - von HubSpot-Automation über Lead-Tracking bis hin zu verlässlichem Reporting.
KI & Automatisierung: Du nutzt aktiv KI-Tools, um Prozesse zu automatisieren - von der Content-Produktion bis hin zu personalisierten Kampagnen.
Agentur-Steuerung: Du bist zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Marketing-Agentur, briefst Kampagnen, gibst Feedback und stellst sicher, dass Ergebnisse geliefert werden.
Sales-Marketing-Alignment: Du bist die aktive Schnittstelle zum Vertrieb und stellst sicher, dass Leads nicht nur generiert, sondern auch konvertiert werden.
Skills to be successful
Erste echte Berufserfahrung: Du bringst 1-3 Jahre Erfahrung im Marketing mit - idealerweise im B2B SaaS-, Tech- oder Startup-Umfeld. Du hast Kampagnen nicht nur betreut, sondern eigenverantwortlich gesteuert und bist damit auch mal auf die Nase gefallen. Beides ist wertvoll.
Akademischer Hintergrund: Abschluss einer Top-Universität oder mit überdurchschnittlichen Noten in Marketing, BWL, Kommunikation o. ä.
Performance-Marketing-Kompetenz: Du kennst dich mit Paid Media auf Google und LinkedIn aus, weißt wie man Kampagnen aufsetzt, optimiert und bewertet. Längere Sales-Cycles und komplexe Buying Center sind dir nicht fremd.
Zahlenaffinität: Bei uns wird alles gemessen und getrackt. Du scheust dich nicht vor Dashboards und KPIs, sondern nutzt sie als Kompass für deine tägliche Arbeit. Zahlen sind für dich die Basis jeder Entscheidung, nicht lästige Pflicht.
HubSpot & Automation: Erfahrung mit HubSpot Marketing Hub - idealerweise inkl. Segmentierung, Automation und Attribution - ist ein klares Plus.
KI-Affinität: Du hast Berührungspunkte mit KI-gestützten Tools in der Content-Produktion oder Lead-Generierung und bist neugierig, das weiterzuentwickeln.
Kreatives Auge: Du hast ein Gespür für Sprache und Design - für LinkedIn-Posts genauso wie für Kampagnen-Creatives. Erfahrung mit Canva oder Adobe Creative Cloud ist ein Plus.
Extreme Ownership: Du brauchst niemanden, der dir sagt was zu tun ist. Wenn du eine Chance siehst, ergreifst du sie. Wenn Hindernisse kommen, überspringst du sie. Du gehst voran.
Kommunikation & Kollaboration: Du kommunizierst klar und präzise - intern wie extern, auf Deutsch und Englisch.

About Nivoda
Nivoda is a fast-growing B2B marketplace that is transforming the global diamond and gemstone industry. We connect buyers and sellers across the world, processing $300M+ in annual transactions and unlocking a $350B industry opportunity. We move fast, think big, and care deeply about the businesses and people we serve.

The diamond trading industry has historically been fragmented, opaque, and inaccessible. Nivoda was founded to change that: to empower businesses of all sizes and locations to participate in a fair, efficient global marketplace. Every line of code, every integration, every automation we build brings us closer to that mission.

We are looking for a Product Marketing Lead to own how Nivoda explains itself: the positioning, the messaging, and the story that makes independent jewellers understand why we are worth switching to. This is the foundation the rest of marketing is built on, from paid campaigns to sales conversations. You will define who we are for, what we say, and why it lands, and then arm the whole go-to-market team to say it consistently.
This is a hands-on role. You will own positioning and messaging, lead the go-to-market for new product launches, sharpen our competitive edge, and build the sales enablement that turns interest into customers.
You will start as a senior individual contributor with real ownership of product marketing end to end. As the company grows there is room to build a function beneath you, but this is a role for a builder who wants to do the work, not just direct it.
What would YOU be doing?
Own Nivoda’s positioning and messaging: define who we are for, the problems we solve, and the words we use, and keep them sharp as the business evolves.
Lead the go-to-market for product launches. Shape the narrative, coordinate across teams, and make sure new features land with the jewellers they are built for.
Build the competitive intelligence that keeps us ahead: understand the alternatives jewellers weigh, and give the team the arguments that win.
Arm our sales team with the enablement they need, from one-pagers and decks to talk tracks, so every conversation tells a consistent and compelling story.
Own the messaging and narrative on our core product and positioning pages, partnering with the teams who own the website and the signup experience.
Shape our pricing and packaging story so the value is obvious and easy to say yes to.
Feed clear, tested messaging into demand gen and content, so campaigns ladder up to one coherent point of view without ever feeling like an ad.
Ground everything in customer truth: talk to jewellers, run win/loss, and turn what you learn into sharper positioning.
Partner closely with product and the growth PM so what we build and how we talk about it stay in lockstep.
What do we need from YOU?
5+ years in product marketing, ideally at a B2B or marketplace company, with a track record of positioning and launches that moved the business.
You are a builder. You would rather write the messaging, run the launch, and ship the deck than hand it off.
Exceptional writing and storytelling. You can take something complex and make it simple, sharp, and persuasive.
A strategic head for positioning: you can define a market, a segment, and a wedge, and defend your choices.
Comfort with data and customer research. You start from evidence, not opinion.
You work well across functions, especially with sales and product, and you build trust quickly.
Comfort as a senior IC on a small team, building process where none exists, with the ambition to grow a function over time.
You are AI forward, always testing new tools, and learnings new applications of AI to improve your efficiency and effectiveness

Experience marketing to small business owners, retailers, or a trade audience.
A marketplace, self-serve, or product-led growth background.
Sales enablement experience for an SDR or inside-sales motion.
Experience running competitive intelligence or win/loss programs.
A real interest in jewellery, retail, or craft, or the curiosity to fall for the space quickly.

Pharmlogic in the room: with the team at sector events, from the stand and the materials to the follow-up, so the people we meet in person get the same clear story as everyone else, and conversations turn into pipeline.

Über uns
Naschen klingt für viele nach schlechtem Gewissen. Bei uns nicht. NaschNatur macht Schokolade, Riegel und Aufstriche, die ausschließlich mit Datteln gesüßt sind statt mit Industriezucker oder anderen Süßungsmitteln – bio, vegan, ohne Zusatzstoffe, mit Zutaten, die man aussprechen kann - und machen daraus Süßes, dass einfach richtig gut schmeckt.
Ob das funktioniert, sagen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden besser als jede Anzeige: 4,94 von 5 Sternen bei über 3.500 Bewertungen. Dazu kommen Nachrichten, für die man sich Zeit nehmen muss — seitenlang, und erstaunlich oft steht darin das Wort „lebensverändernd". Menschen, die ihren Zuckerkonsum umgestellt haben und uns erzählen, was sich dadurch für sie verändert hat.
Genau da setzt diese Rolle an. Wer sich für weniger Zucker entscheidet, entscheidet sich nicht einmal — sondern jeden Tag neu. Wir wollen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden auf diesem Weg begleiten: mit E-Mails und Nachrichten, die zum richtigen Zeitpunkt kommen, die weiterhelfen statt nur zu verkaufen, und die aus einer guten Entscheidung eine Gewohnheit machen. Dafür suchen wir dich.
Deine Mission
Du machst aus Erstkäufern Stammkunden. Du verantwortest unser CRM — Flows, Kampagnen, Segmentierung — baust WhatsApp als neuen Kanal von Grund auf auf und entwickelst unser Treue- und Referral-Programm. Deine Nordstern-Metrik: die Wiederkaufrate.
Ausgangslage
Es gibt bei NaschNatur bisher kein CRM-Team, keine Agentur und keine gewachsene Struktur. Klaviyo läuft, erste Flows stehen — der Rest ist offen. Du bist die erste Person, die diesen Bereich verantwortet und ihn von hier aus aufbaut.
Das heißt in den ersten Monaten: Du machst fast alles selbst. Flows bauen, Segmente anlegen, Kampagnen einplanen, WhatsApp-Setup aufsetzen, Reportings ziehen, Tools evaluieren. Es gibt niemanden, an den du Umsetzung abgeben kannst. Hands-on ist in dieser Rolle keine Floskel, sondern die Arbeitsbeschreibung — die Strategie entsteht beim Bauen, nicht davor.
Aufgaben
Du verantwortest unser E-Mail-Marketing in Klaviyo end-to-end: Flows (Welcome, Post-Purchase, Win-Back), Kampagnen, Segmentierung, A/B-Tests, Deliverability

Du baust unseren WhatsApp-Kanal auf: Opt-in-Strecken, Automationen, Kanalstrategie — und verzahnst ihn sauber mit der E-Mail statt ihn danebenzustellen
Du entwickelst und betreibst unser Treueprogramm und unser Referral-Programm
Du baust unsere Lifecycle-Logik über alle Kanäle: Wer bekommt wann welche Botschaft — und wer bewusst keine

Our highest-value accounts should not be managed as a series of campaigns. The goal is to build an account-growth system that becomes more intelligent, more effective, and more valuable with every cycle.
There is no established function to inherit and no finished playbook to manage. You will define what account-based marketing should mean for Fresh Prints, build the operating model behind it, and drive the business to execute against it across Marketing, Sales, Creative, Data, and Operations.
We are not looking for someone who will optimize the existing approach at the margins. We are looking for someone who will question its assumptions, identify the few bets that could materially change account value, and take responsibility for turning those bets into results.

Defining how Fresh Prints grows and retains its most valuable accounts at the company level, not simply running better campaigns.
Building an account strategy that continues to work as chapters, decision-makers, relationships, and buying cycles change.
Identifying the few highest-leverage bets that could materially increase account value, then focusing the business around them.
Turning strategy into execution through direct ownership, cross-functional influence, and systems that scale.
Shaping how Marketing, Sales, Operations, and account-facing teams approach retention, expansion, and long-term account development.
Building account growth into a durable business capability, not an initiative that resets every campaign cycle.

Company-Level Account Strategy
Build the long-term growth strategy for Fresh Prints’ highest-value accounts.
Define how the business should identify, segment, prioritise, invest in, retain, and expand those accounts over time.
Develop a strategy that remains effective even as student leaders, decision-makers, buying committees, and internal account owners change.

Shape decisions across sales motions, customer experience, and account coverage when those decisions are necessary to unlock growth.

Take responsibility for moving the strategy from an idea into how the company actually operates.

Use AI, automation, process, and disciplined prioritisation to operate with the leverage of a much larger team.
Partner with Sales, BDM, Campus Manager leadership, Marketing, Creative, Data, and Operations to translate the strategy into clear actions, ownership, and operating rhythms.
Build the systems, decision rules, and playbooks that allow teams to execute the strategy correctly without depending on you to manage every action.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Represent account growth and retention in executive-level conversations.
Bring a clear, evidence-backed point of view on where the company should place its bets, what it should stop doing, and what needs to change.
Build the commercial case and organisational support required to secure resources, change priorities, and influence how teams operate.

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.
With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.
Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement.

We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

We’re looking for a Solutions Marketing Manager to shape how LangChain brings its full platform to priority industries, enterprise buyers, and high-value use cases.
This role sits at the intersection of product and GTM. You’ll translate customer problems into clear solution narratives, repeatable sales plays, campaign themes, and customer-facing assets that help teams understand where LangChain fits in their AI strategy.
You’ll develop industry solutions, use case solutions, and enterprise solution stories for segments such as financial services, healthcare, life sciences, and other priority markets. You’ll work closely with sales, solutions, product, demand generation, field marketing, education, and customer teams to understand what matters in the field, turn those insights into messaging and collateral, and help create programs that support pipeline and revenue generation.
The role covers the full LangChain platform, including Observability & Evaluation, Deployment, Sandboxes, LLM Gateway, Fleet, Engine, and OSS. The goal is to explain how these products work together to help companies build, deploy, monitor, and improve agents in production.
You’ll define the problems we solve for specific audiences, package those into repeatable narratives, and help GTM teams take them to market.

Develop industry and use case solutions
Build solution narratives for priority industries and enterprise use cases. Initial focus areas include financial services, healthcare, and life sciences, with room to expand based on GTM priorities.
Translate customer problems into clear solution stories. You’ll connect LangChain’s platform capabilities to the business, operational, governance, and technical needs of specific audiences.
Define repeatable use case messaging. You’ll identify where agents can create value across functions and industries, then turn those patterns into solution briefs, use case pages, campaign assets, sales decks, webinar narratives, and customer-facing content.
Build a point of view on enterprise AI adoption. You’ll help explain how companies move from prototypes and isolated experiments to production deployments with the controls, visibility, and evaluation practices they need.
Stay close to the market. You’ll synthesize customer conversations, sales feedback, competitive activity, industry trends, and product signals into sharper messaging and GTM recommendations.
Support enterprise GTM motions
Partner with sales, solutions, field marketing, demand generation, and customer-facing teams on targeted enterprise campaigns and account motions.
Build sales enablement for industry and enterprise conversations. This may include talk tracks, discovery questions, objection handling, use case maps, executive-ready decks, demo narratives, and competitive context.
Turn field learnings into reusable sales plays. You’ll work with account teams to understand what resonates with buyers and turn those insights into repeatable messaging, collateral, and campaign programs.
Create materials for complex buying committees. You’ll help LangChain speak clearly to technical buyers, AI leaders, IT and security stakeholders, business leaders, and functional teams.
Support pipeline and revenue programs. You’ll help connect solution narratives to campaigns, events, webinars, ABM motions, field programs, and sales follow-up.

You have 3–6+ years of experience in solutions marketing, enterprise marketing, product marketing, developer marketing, industry marketing, or a related GTM role.
You’ve built messaging, collateral, or campaigns around technical products, AI/ML products, developer tools, B2B SaaS, infrastructure, automation, productivity tools, or platform products.
You can turn customer problems into clear solution narratives. You know how to move from “what the product does” to “why this matters for this audience, industry, or use case.”
You understand enterprise buying motions. You know how to create assets for complex buying committees, regulated industries, sales-led motions, and executive conversations.
You’re comfortable with technical products. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be able to learn technical concepts quickly, ask good questions, and translate details into customer-facing messaging.
You like working with sales and customer-facing teams. You’re interested in what happens in the field and know how to turn that feedback into stronger messaging and enablement.
You’re comfortable working across many audiences, including developers, technical buyers, operators, admins, AI leaders, business stakeholders, and nontechnical end users.
You can balance strategic thinking with execution. You can define a messaging POV, then build the deck, brief, landing page copy, or sales asset that brings it to life.
You’re comfortable with ambiguity and iteration. The market for production-ready AI agents is still being defined, and you’re excited to ship, learn, and improve.
You have genuine curiosity about agents, enterprise AI adoption, and how they will change how teams work.

Experience building industry or solutions marketing programs for financial services, healthcare, life sciences, public sector, or other regulated industries.
Experience supporting enterprise sales teams through enablement, account-based campaigns, customer-facing storytelling, competitive support, or executive-facing collateral.
Familiarity with the LLM, agent, or AI application development ecosystem.
Experience with PLG motions, onboarding, activation, lifecycle marketing, or self-serve adoption.
You’ll help build the solutions marketing motion at LangChain. There is room to shape how we define priority industries, package use cases, support enterprise campaigns, and enable the field.

Run end-to-end integrated, multichannel campaigns across the Netherlands, Belgium, and Luxembourg, spanning brand awareness, demand generation, lead nurturing, and account-based marketing (ABM).

We're looking for our founding APAC Field Marketing Leader, someone strategy-strong who can autonomously own a regional function end to end — set the strategy, build the operating system, carry the number, and represent marketing credibly to regional sales leadership and to global marketing leadership at the same time. Not a program manager who executes a plan set elsewhere.
The essential tension to screen for: this person needs the seniority and judgment to lead an org, and the willingness to be a team of one for a while. Regional expansion is planned but the timing isn't fixed, which means for some meaningful period they are writing the doc, running the roundtable, and negotiating with the agency themselves. Scrappy, low-ego, and hands-on — but senior enough to see the whole picture without the support systems a mature regional marketing org would provide.
Regional judgment matters more here than in most field marketing roles. One person cannot serve five sub-regions equally, so the job is fundamentally about sequencing: which markets get real first-party investment, which get partner-led coverage, and which wait. They need to make those calls, defend them to sales leaders in each market, and revisit them as signal comes in.
Partner fluency is not a nice-to-have in this region — it's the primary distribution mechanism. Someone who has only run first-party programs will find the leverage model unfamiliar.
What a successful candidate looks like: a leader who landed in a new region with nothing, picked the right two markets to prove out, used partner and agency capacity to punch well above their headcount, and can point to the pipeline, the operating system, and the team plan they left behind.
Ideal Profiles
The first-in-region builder who then scaled it. Was the founding field or regional marketing hire for APAC at an enterprise software company and grew it into a team. Brings direct experience with both halves of this job. Pressure-test whether they built a durable function or just ran events, and whether they're still willing to be hands-on at the start.
The partner-led regional leader. Led co-marketing and demand programs through cloud providers, resellers, and distributors across APAC markets. Strongest on leverage and ecosystem motion. Pressure-test whether they can also build direct enterprise ABM and own a pipeline number independent of partners.
The multi-market APAC field marketing leader. Owned field marketing across several APAC sub-regions at a scaled tech company. Brings market fluency, local vendor and event relationships, and cultural range. Pressure-test appetite for building infrastructure from scratch rather than operating within an existing system, and for the period before they have a team.

Principales responsabilidades

Diseñar y producir las piezas de cada lanzamiento en Figma: emails, landings, banners in-app, social, one-pagers y presentaciones comerciales

Crear plantillas en Canva que permitan a otros equipos producir formatos simples sin romper la marca
Ser el guardián de la consistencia: que todo lo que sale se vea Xepelin, sin excepciones.

Product Marketing no se limita a producir piezas. Cuando un producto necesita que alguien entienda al cliente antes de escribir la primera línea, cuando un lanzamiento requiere quien lo coordine de punta a punta, o cuando una decisión de mensaje necesita evidencia y no opinión: este rol entra.
Voz del cliente: levantar y sintetizar señales de clientes —entrevistas, tickets, comportamiento en producto— para alimentar el mensaje con evidencia
Inteligencia competitiva: monitorear qué dice el mercado y traducirlo en implicancias concretas para nuestro mensaje
Nuevos mercados y segmentos: adaptar mensaje y piezas cuando un producto cruza a otro mercado o se abre a un segmento nuevo

Rigor con los datos: cuando alguien dice "la campaña funcionó bien", tu reflejo es preguntar comparado con qué

Hi, I’m Harriet, Ashby’s VP Marketing. I joined Ashby in August 2022 to lead the Marketing function. My career journey has been anything but linear starting out as a yoga teacher, working as an M&A lawyer, before finding my happy place in marketing. This is a common theme across the team, and we love to see people who have built their skills both inside and outside the marketing discipline.
Over the past ~4 years, we’ve gone from a stealth brand to the default operating system for over 5,000 of the most ambitious companies in tech, finance, and healthcare.

On this journey, we’ve also amassed a marketing team of ~30 folks from across North America and Europe who are some of the brightest and most humble humans that want to ‘win’, and have fun doing so.

Our culture is focused on creating a space to do lots of career-defining work with the tools, people, and focus that means minimal thrash and lots of autonomy. You can learn a little more about how we work here and why our investors are excited about us here .
For this role, we are looking for someone to lead demand generation for our enterprise segment in Europe. You will have a fantastic thought partner and US counterpart, Ben , as well as the autonomy to rethink and define the strategy and execution to fit the nuances of the different European markets.

It’s ABM but not in its traditional form: we’re seeking a first-principles thinker who prioritizes meaningful engagement over generic tactics / outdated playbooks (for example, prioritizing a few key impactful moments of engagement over running a laundry list of generic tactics across digital channels).
If working with both the sales and marketing team to find and convert enterprise pipeline in a low ego, highly ambitious environment appeals, we’d love to hear from you!
What you’ll be responsible for in this role
Partner with Ben to define our EMEA enterprise ABM strategy and the channels we bet on with consideration to broader global strategy and nuances of respective European markets. Here you play the critical role of orchestrator, pulling together all of the relevant marketing channels to support a delightful discovery and prospect journey and are the point person for your counterparts in Sales.
Research and build prospect journey maps for target accounts, and develop the messaging, content, and creative that bring them to life, with support from our PMM, content, and creative teams.
Work with sales and revenue operations to build target account lists that combine data signals with rep input, and own the methodology behind them — how cohorts are built, what assumptions they rest on, and how we measure whether accounts are actually moving.
Manage our agency partners, including our gifting agency, Wildcard, to get campaigns executed well and fast.
Execute on the strategy you define which will include activities like working with your events counterpart on the coordination of dinners, activations , ancillary conference events, and stunts.
Apply our experimentation framework to run short sprints, learn quickly what works, and localise content, creative, and campaign strategy for EMEA markets.

s.h: You will probably love this role if
s.t:
You enjoy combining data and creative thinking — and you have taste. You can tell the difference between messaging that's genuinely compelling and messaging that's generic or cheesy.
You're prospect-obsessed. You can step into the seat of the personas you're marketing to and build campaigns that meet them where they are, at the right time, with the right message.
You are deeply curious and not afraid to break from traditional ABM playbooks.
You build trust across functions. Sales managers and reps are excited to work with you, and the marketing team is fully bought into your campaign ideas and asks.
You understand (and leverage) the massive advantage AI creates but not so pilled that you let efficiency gains undercut creativity and taste.

s.h: This role is not for you if
s.t:
You'd rely solely on 6sense (or equivalent) as your only source of truth.
You're strong on one half of the job but not the other. You need to move comfortably between building and interpreting dashboards, and writing compelling copy and developing creative with our gifting agency and creative teams.
You lean heavily on existing playbooks and tactics rather than stepping back and thinking from first principles. A lot of how we market at Ashby is deliberately different; curiosity and adaptability are critical.
You aren't able to operate with autonomy and run strategies end-to-end. We give clear ownership and trust you with it; you should be proactive and resourceful.
You believe that EMEA is one homogeneous market
Interview Plan
At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. We’ll dive into past projects and simulate working together via project working sessions. Our interview process is five rounds:
30-minute intro call with Michelle (Recruiting).
45-minute interview with Harriet (Hiring Manager).
45-minute interview with Ben (US lead on ABM).
A take-home assignment, which you’ll have 40 mins to discuss with the hiring team.
A virtual on-site of 1.5 hours with a panel of interviewers.
Nhi (Strategic Projects Lead)
Casper (Head of ENT Sales, EMEA)
Antonio (AI & Automations Lead, Demand Gen)

Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team.
10-year exercise window for stock options . You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it .
Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
$100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Orbital is looking for a Product Marketing Manager to lead how our product releases are brought to market and adopted.
As our product and release cadence continue to grow, this role will turn a steady stream of new capabilities into clear, compelling stories for customers, prospects and the wider market. You’ll work across the product roadmap to understand what matters most, shape how releases are positioned, and coordinate how and when they reach the right audiences.
You’ll independently lead a broad portfolio of product and feature launches, while playing a key supporting role in Tier 1 launches alongside our Senior Product Marketing Manager. You’ll also help embed and evolve the systems that enable us to launch consistently at scale, from our existing launch framework and calendar to our changelog, in-product communications and Help Centre.
This is a high-autonomy role at the intersection of Product, Marketing and Customer Success. It’s a great opportunity for a product marketer who combines strong messaging skills with excellent execution and enjoys creating structure around a fast-moving product organisation.

Lead product launches end to end. Own the go-to-market strategy and execution for a portfolio of product and feature launches, from defining the audience and customer value through messaging, channel strategy, timing and measurement.
Run and evolve our launch programme. Implement our existing launch framework across Product and Marketing, managing roadmap intake, launch tiering and a single launch calendar. You’ll help teams apply the framework consistently and iterate it over time based on what we learn from launches and adoption.
Develop positioning and messaging. Turn complex product capabilities into clear, compelling value propositions and messaging that resonate with customers, prospects and the wider market.
Drive awareness and adoption. Plan how releases are brought to market across in-product messaging, email, the changelog, website and other channels, ensuring the right audiences understand what’s new, why it matters and how it strengthens the value of Orbital.
Own our product changelog. Build and manage an external changelog that gives customers and prospects a clear, useful and always-current view of what’s new in Orbital.
Evolve our Help Centre. Partner with Product and Customer Support to keep product education accurate, useful and up to date, and improve the experience through stronger written, visual and video content.
Raise the quality of product marketing. Create clear standards, templates and guidance that help teams communicate new capabilities effectively across customer and market-facing channels. You’ll act as an editor and trusted partner to Product, helping turn subject-matter expertise into high-quality product marketing.
Measure launch impact. Define and track success metrics across awareness, activation and adoption, using the results to improve how we prioritise, plan and execute future launches.
Partner across go-to-market teams. Work closely with Revenue Enablement, Customer Success and the wider Marketing team to ensure launches translate into effective market education, customer adoption, campaigns and commercial readiness.

s.h: How you’ll work with the team
s.t:
You’ll work closely with our Senior Product Marketing Manager, who leads overarching product positioning and Tier 1 launches. You’ll independently own a high volume of product and feature launches, while contributing to Tier 1 launches and helping ensure our overall launch programme works as one coherent system.
You’ll also partner closely with Product Managers across our UK and US products, as well as Revenue Enablement, Customer Success, Product Design and the wider Marketing team.
Your first few months
You’ll start by building a deep understanding of our product, customers, market and current launch process, working closely with Product teams and spending time with customers.
From there, you’ll embed our launch framework and calendar across the product organisation, launch our external changelog, and take ownership of your first major product launch.
You’ll also refine the playbooks and templates that help teams execute great launches consistently as Orbital continues to grow.
